snippet.title: I made a Crash x Beyblade Fangame: WOAHBLADE!
snippet.description:
I couldn't find any Crash Bandicoot x Beyblade Spin-Off fangames so I made one.

I made this for fun in my own time. All the assets were made by me. Models were crafted lovingly in Blender, textures made noncommitally in Krita, and audio was gently screamed by my own voice and body parts into a consumer grade headset that I recorded and edited using Reaper and Audacity.

The font is Crash-a-Like by Aryel Filipe.

This is a fangame! Crash Bandicoot, Spyro and Beyblade belong to their respective owners Activision and Hasbro, who I have no affiliation with. I have no plans to update it further. It was a load of fun to make, though!

Special thanks to my friends M & L for playtesting and feedback, and to the Spyro Reddit Discord community for this larger playtest which made this trailer possible. Y'all rock.
